brief.headline: US wholesale inflation jumps most in four years on gas
brief.detail: Wholesale prices surged in September as energy costs spiked, posting the largest monthly increase in more than four years, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

brief.headline: Jio Platforms files for mega IPO, issue opens Oct 21
brief.detail: Jio Platforms filed its red herring prospectus for an IPO that will open on October 21, a record-breaking offering that is drawing heavy investor attention.

brief.headline: Anthropic urged to pause IPO over AI safety risks
brief.detail: New York City's comptroller said Anthropic should pause its initial public offering until it has fully addressed risks around artificial intelligence.

brief.headline: Asian stocks sell off as AI trades crumble
brief.detail: Asian stocks sold off as AI trades crumbled after hot US inflation data, adding to pressure on risk assets across global markets.

brief.headline: Berkshire deepens Bending Spoons bet with $330 million
brief.detail: Berkshire Hathaway added $330 million to its Bending Spoons investment, sparking a share rally in the company as investors respond to the bigger stake.
